## Problem and behavior

Describe the trigger and resulting behavior for someone who has not read the discussion.

## Scope and evidence

List intended paths, regression/refusal checks, package or installed-surface evidence, and actual results. Preserve failures and explain optional skips. State remaining host limitations.

## Cleanup and compatibility

Confirm unrelated changes, user settings, ownership protection, vendor notices, and release versions are preserved. Record temporary resources and cleanup. Do not include private session data. Release actions require a separate maintainer decision.
